In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the local microenvironment influences the tumor progression in several ways.
tumor invasion is a dynamic process that is regulated by multiple extrinsic and intrinsic factors.
the basement membrane is a physical barrier for tumor invasion, and its disruption by tumor cells is an important step in the progression of the disease.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the basement membrane is a key player in constraining tumor invasion, while the stroma is more permissive.
we show that the composition of the tumor microenvironment can influence the behavior of tumor cells.
we show that a basement membrane-like ECM, in particular the laminin isoform, can act as a barrier to prevent tumor cell dissemination.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tumor microenvironment can have a dramatic effect on tumor cell behavior, even in the context of the same tumor.
the extracellular matrix is a dynamic and heterogeneous environment that influences tumor cell behavior in a complex manner.
the tumor microenvironment can be a barrier to metastatic progression.
